svg.text: IL-PROOF-022
What this evaluation is bounded by

text.font-family: Courier, 'Courier New', Menlo, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: THE CORPUS
Sixteen scenarios across two hazard families. Every rate is a property of this
corpus and is not a population estimate. No confidence intervals: the decision
core is deterministic and the corpus is enumerated exhaustively, so there is no
sampling process.

text.font-family: Courier, 'Courier New', Menlo, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: NOT TESTED, AND NOT CLAIMED
no same-target atomicity and target-side compare-and-set
no exactly-once execution
no restart and recovery behaviour
no joint human authorization
no Agent Runtime and Agent Gateway participation

text.font-family: Courier, 'Courier New', Menlo, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: NEGATIVE FINDING, RETAINED

text.font-family: Courier, 'Courier New', Menlo, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: inadmissible evidence failed closed 8/8

text.font-family: Courier, 'Courier New', Menlo, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: exact refusal-reason agreement 6/8
Every inadmissible-evidence scenario failed closed and applied no mutation. Exact refusal-reason agreement with the frozen corpus was lower: two scenarios refused with
HISTORY_NOT_MINED where the corpus predicted HISTORY_EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE. The envelope's completeness state is NOT_MINED, so the decision core took the
correct branch and the corpus expectation was mistaken. Neither mismatch permitted a mutation. The corpus is frozen and stays wrong on the record.
